title: 2021 ENADE Bachelor in Computer Science exam
summary: Brazilian undergraduate computer science students answer open and multiple-choice questions containing text and visual material in the national ENADE examination. This paper tests ChatGPT-4 Vision on the same images; students did not use AI during the reported exam.

sources.title: Evaluating ChatGPT-4 Vision on Brazil's National Undergraduate Computer Science Exam
sources.evidence_quote: The BCS exam comprised 40 questions: 10 questions assessed general education, while 30 questions assessed the specific knowledge of BCS students.
